rationale: Despite strong relative volume and intraday outperformance against a weak broader market, the last two 1-minute bars show a sharp pickup in selling volume that pushed the price below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($24.58). Furthermore, the bid-ask spread is relatively wide at 20.4 bps ($0.05), representing nearly half of the 5-minute ATR ($0.1113), which degrades the risk-to-reward profile for either a pullback long or a counter-trend short right now.
